extracted.name: Soft and Chewy Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
extracted.description: These oatmeal raisin cookies are made with canola oil instead of butter for a soft, chewy, and tender texture. Perfect for a sweet treat!
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease two cookie sheets.

Whisk canola oil, brown sugar, eggs, and vanilla together in a large bowl until well blended. Combine flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg in a separate bowl; stir into the canola oil mixture until combined. Stir in oats and raisins until evenly distributed. Drop rounded spoonfuls of dough 2 inches apart onto the prepared cookie sheets.

Bake in the preheated oven until the edges are lightly browned and the centers are set, 10 to 12 minutes. Let cookies cool on the baking sheets for 5 minutes. Transfer to wire racks and cool completely.
